comparison_domain: Rishiganga hydropower project (~15 km downstream of the Ronti Peak source) and Tapovan-Vishnugad (upstream and downstream of the project intake)
x_preview_framing: Chamoli 2021 was a rock-and-ice avalanche that transformed into a debris flow and downstream flood -- it was NOT a glacial lake outburst or a dam-breach flood (docs/events/chamoli_2021.md line 8). Event model for Chamoli 2021 not yet defined; comparison layout only. docs/real_input_checklist.json rishiganga.event_model_contract is CONTRACT DECISION REQUIRED: 'the current dam-breach contract cannot describe the observed mass flow.' This screen shows what workstream 8 (historical validation) would look like once that decision is made; it is not, and cannot become, a dam-breach validation for this event.

event_type.value: Rock-and-ice avalanche from Ronti Peak, transformed into a debris flow and downstream flood

material_composition.value: approximately 80% rock, 20% glacier ice by volume

rishiganga_frontal_speed_ms.basis: observed, ~15 km downstream of source, docs/events/chamoli_2021.md line 15-16

tapovan_upstream_frontal_speed_ms.basis: observed, just upstream of the project, docs/events/chamoli_2021.md line 18

tapovan_downstream_frontal_speed_ms.basis: observed, below the project, docs/events/chamoli_2021.md line 18-19

tapovan_downstream_mean_discharge_m3s.basis: observed, poorer model agreement reported near the project, docs/events/chamoli_2021.md line 19-20

debris_blockage_height_m.basis: observed, near the Ronti Gad confluence, docs/events/chamoli_2021.md line 21

landslide_lake_length_m.basis: observed, formed behind the debris blockage, docs/events/chamoli_2021.md line 21-22

total_deposit_volume_m3.basis: observed, at and just downstream of the confluence, docs/events/chamoli_2021.md line 22

predicted.method: No admissible event model exists for this avalanche (docs/real_input_checklist.json rishiganga.event_model_contract: CONTRACT DECISION REQUIRED). The single estimate below is NOT a prediction at Rishiganga or Tapovan -- it is what the project's ordinary clear-water breach-profile formula outputs AT THE SOURCE if fed the event's real observed volume and neutral reference defaults (breach_width_m=120, failure_time_s=3600, the same defaults used elsewhere in this preview), with no multiplier or target direction applied. It is not routed downstream and is not comparable to the observed values below, which are at different locations.

source_peak_depth_m.basis: illustrative — not a model performance finding

source_peak_velocity_ms.basis: illustrative — not a model performance finding

source_peak_discharge_m3s.basis: illustrative — not a model performance finding

provenance.note: Every observed.* value is real, from src_042 (Shugar et al. 2021, Science 373, eabh4455) as summarized in docs/events/chamoli_2021.md, with the exact supporting line cited in each field's basis/note. No observed value here is estimated or guessed -- anything the doc doesn't state is simply absent from this fixture, not filled in. predicted.* is a single neutral, undirected estimate computed by gen_preview_assets.py:gen_chamoli_illustrative_source_estimate() at the source only (not routed to Rishiganga/Tapovan, since no distance/routing source exists) -- it carries no target direction and is not scored against the observed values (different location), so metrics is empty rather than showing a fabricated comparison.
